scope: The app's own inference, which runs only when a reader asks for a passage. Never read by scripts/llm/free_router.mjs and never an automation fallback.

paid_lanes.purpose: The reading product itself: passages, comprehension questions, assessments, answer evaluation, the tutor, read-aloud text and vocabulary confirmation.
paid_lanes.why_not_free: A reader waiting on a passage is the product working, not an unattended probe. The owner's zero-paid rule governs what this repo runs on a schedule; this lane runs only on a request from the app and is funded by the Lovable project's own credit.
paid_lanes.gated_by: supabase/functions/_shared/guard.ts guardPaid(): no anonymous caller and no caller over the limit reaches the gateway. supabase/functions/_shared/guard.test.ts proves both with the paid call mocked, and runs in check.yml.
paid_lanes.guard: scripts/check-llm-routing.mjs keeps this lane listed here: a provider endpoint called from server code that is in neither this manifest nor the free router fails the build, so a new paid call site cannot appear unrecorded.
paid_lanes.open_question_2026_11_03: The Lovable AI gateway serves Google Gemini models, and the Gemini API Additional Terms (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms) say the API is not for services directed to, or likely to be accessed by, individuals under 18. dailystory removed the Lovable gateway from Time-2-Read's children's text chain on 26 Oct 2026 for exactly that clause. This app is a reading product for ages 5-85+, so the same clause reads across to it. Recorded here, not changed: which provider a children's product may call is the owner's ruling and the risk brain's rule, not an audit pass's call. Raised with her on 3 Nov 2026.
